title: Remote protocol v1 error catalog
description: Stable error codes. Internal exceptions must be mapped here; stacks never go on the wire.

errors.clientAction: Fix the frame or params. Do not retry unchanged.
Close the connection and stop. Upgrade the client.
Re-authenticate. If tokens are revoked, return to login.
Stop. The caller is not the unique admin or the host rejected the action.
Show offline state. Do not queue writes. Retry only after the host is online.
The method is not in the v1 registry. Do not retry.
Do not reuse the expired frame. Query state, then send a new write with a new expiresAt and the same idempotencyKey only if the original never executed.
Treat as the original result if provided, otherwise refresh state. Do not execute again.
Read-only calls may retry. Writes must resume or query; do not mint a new idempotencyKey.
Backoff and slow consumption. Do not increase send rate.
Refresh the resource and present the current state.
Remove stale UI state and resync.
Retry reads with backoff. Writes stay unknown until resume or resource query.
